lead: Ben Stokes is best known as a British cricketer, born on 4 June 1991 in Christchurch.
As of 2026, he is 35 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has represented England cricket team and Durham County Cricket Club and has been recognised with Officer of the Order of the British Empire and Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
This profile collects the Ben facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

paras: Ben Stokes was born on 4 June 1991 in Christchurch, and holds British and New Zealander nationality.

He received his education at Cockermouth School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Ben Stokes — Career and Professional Work
paras: Ben Stokes works primarily as a cricketer.

On the team sheet, Ben has been associated with England cricket team (from 2013 to 2018), Durham County Cricket Club (from 2009), Melbourne Renegades (from 2015 to 2015), Rising Pune Supergiant (from 2017 to 2017), Canterbury cricket team (from 2017 to 2017) and Rajasthan Royals (from 2018).
